title: Daily reach ceiling ~22 impressions: total reach saturates at 3-4 posts/day and extra posts add none, so the production axis cannot move growth
evidence: MEASURED from scheduling_posts, real posts only (provider_post_id IS NOT NULL, insights-backed reach), mature days Aug 22-Sep 9 (all >=12d old so reach has settled) -- total daily reach by volume band: 1 post/day 11.2 (n=5 days); 2/day 17.3 (n=3); 3-4/day 22.8 (n=4); 5-9/day 22.3 (n=6). Total reach SATURATES at ~22 impressions/day by 3-4 posts/day; 5-9 posts/day adds NOTHING (22.3 vs 22.8). Per-post reach falls 4x across the same bands (11.2 -> 8.7 -> 6.5 -> 3.0). Pearson r(posts/day, per-post reach) = -0.775 over 22 days. Age is NOT the driver: the OLDEST most-mature days (Aug 26-30, 8-9 posts/day) carry total reach 16-27 while NEWER low-volume days (Sep 6-9, 1 post/day) carry 11-13, i.e. age works AGAINST the observed pattern. CONSEQUENCE: the account has a hard daily reach ceiling of ~22 impressions. The configured cadence (posts_per_day=3, max_posts_per_day=3) already sits AT the saturation knee, so cadence is not the defect and needs no change -- but no cadence setting can raise the ceiling. With 143 real published posts yielding 16 likes / 0 comments / 2 saves LIFETIME (0 comments ever), and followers flat at 150-158 across 33 days (151 on 08-21 -> 158 on 09-22, dipping to 150 in late Aug), the production axis is exhausted: reach does not scale with output and nothing converts. Sep 18-21 days sit BELOW the ceiling (total 7-10/day at 3-5 posts), which volume does not explain -- consistent with distribution degradation, and the reason the pre-registered pivot candidate is DISTRIBUTION/REACH. MEASUREMENT INTEGRITY (secondary finding): 65 rows in scheduling_posts are TEST FIXTURES -- caption 'test', provider_post_id NULL, reach pinned at 1000, posted_at 2026-08-18..21, insights_updated_at NULL. They carry 2181 of the account's apparent 'likes' and inflate any aggregate that filters on reach IS NOT NULL instead of insights_updated_at IS NOT NULL. They are EXCLUDED today from Growth::GateRead (filters insights_updated_at NOT NULL) and from Growth::WeeklyReview (REVIEW_WINDOW_DAYS=7), so no live read is contaminated -- but Growth::WeeklyReview#posted_posts filters on photo_id only, so a wider window would include them. Left in place deliberately: deleting rows is a destructive write outside this loop's authority. DECISION: keep cadence at 3/day (at the knee, no change needed); no production lever remains that can move engagement; the 09-28 gate's engagement leg cannot be passed by changing how much is published.
